item.title: NHL roundup: Reinhart's two goals lead Panthers to 5-2 win over Lightning
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. (AP) — Sam Reinhart scored a short-handed goal and a power-play goal to lead the Florida Panthers to a 5-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Monday night.

item.title: Billions on the line as Newfoundland launches four-month review of Quebec hydro deal
item.description: ST. JOHN'S — Newfoundland and Labrador's new premier launched a review of a major draft energy deal with Hydro-Québec on Monday, promising a three-person panel to investigate whether the agreement best serves the cash-strapped province.
